name: Curator Beastie
oracle_text:
Reach
Colorless creatures you control enter with two additional +1/+1 counters on them.
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, manifest dread. (Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
blocked_sentences: Colorless creatures you control enter with two additional +1/+1 counters on them.

needs.what: a face-down permanent must be subject to counters and to statics about arriving permanents: (1) `enters_with_additional_counters` must apply to a face-down arrival (manifest / manifest dread / cloak), matching its filter against the face-down characteristics (colorless 2/2 creature, 708.2) so a manifested-dread permanent under Curator Beastie enters with two +1/+1 counters; (2) +1/+1 counters on a face-down permanent must modify its power/toughness (layer 7c applies over the 708.2 2/2 shell), so it is a 4/4
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Tested: with Curator Beastie on the battlefield (static `enters_with_additional_counters`, affects {controller: you, types: [Creature], colorless: true}), manifest dread puts the chosen card onto the battlefield face down with 0 +1/+1 counters, so the static is not applied to the face-down entrant (`zones._board_additional_counters` is not applied to the manifest arrival); and forcing two +1/+1 counters onto the face-down permanent still leaves `chars` at 2/2, because `chars` returns FACE_DOWN_CHARS before any static or counter is layered (rules-coverage 'Face-down permanents are a bare shell'). `manifest_dread` itself now works; this sentence is what blocks the card.
